description: This file defines a mock class CdmServiceMock for the ICdmService interface, used for unit testing within the Rialto server media service. It includes mock method declarations for various CDM (Content Decryption Module) related operations.

classes.name: CdmServiceMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the ICdmService interface for testing purposes, providing mocked methods for CDM operations.

methods.name: switchToActive
methods.description: Mocks the transition of the CDM to an active state.

methods.name: switchToInactive
methods.description: Mocks the transition of the CDM to an inactive state.

methods.name: createMediaKeys
methods.description: Mocks the creation of media keys with a specified handle and key system.

methods.name: destroyMediaKeys
methods.description: Mocks the destruction of media keys with a specified handle.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Mocks the creation of a key session with specified parameters.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Mocks the generation of a license request for a key session.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Mocks loading an existing session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Mocks updating a session with response data.

methods.name: closeKeySession
methods.description: Mocks closing a key session.

methods.name: removeKeySession
methods.description: Mocks removing a key session.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Mocks checking if a key exists in a session.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Mocks setting the DRM header for a session.

methods.name: deleteDrmStore
methods.description: Mocks deleting the DRM store.

methods.name: deleteKeyStore
methods.description: Mocks deleting the key store.

methods.name: getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the hash of the DRM store.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the hash of the key store.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the LDL sessions limit.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the last DRM error.

methods.name: getDrmTime
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the DRM time.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Mocks retrieving supported key systems.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Mocks checking support for a specific key system.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the version of a supported key system.
